index.description: Nous sommes une organisation qui fait des concerts pour les artistes inconnu-e-s.
index.events.description: Une liste de nos évènements, futur, present et passés.
events.2026tour2.description: The first part of the tour was truly incredible, so much so that we wanted to keep going through the end of 2026. Thanks so much for all your support, can’t wait for these 6 new dates. Thanks to all the venues and organizations supporting and taking part in this tour !🌀🫶
events.2026tour.description: It’s been a while since we’ve wanted to come to new cities across France, you’ve been asking us for it too! It took some time, but here we are, our first fully independent tour, alongside amazing organizers Blob, Manigance, SUPER8 and Cartel BZH, as well as all the venues, and with all the artists soon to be revealed! 🫶💙
events.reves15.description: We're very happy to be able to announce this new Rêves, with yet again so many artist we hold near and dear to our hearts 💙
events.reves14part2.description: Thank you so much for all the love and support for Rêves 14! So many of you asked for a part 2! See you on Sunday, September 7th, for a concert format from 8 PM to 11 PM, can’t wait 💙
events.reves14.description: Really happy to be back with this 14th edition, bringing back Peterparker69 (R11) and pinponpanpon (RTokyo) from previous Rêves, along with new artists like notinbed and tarozan, plus our favorite Parisian DJs Lorenzi, yume, and DJ PUPPYLUV.
